name: tearoff
title: Tearoff
description: An evening-classes theme drawn as the photocopied flyer on lilac copier paper, whose weekly timetable is the fringe of tear-off strips along its foot: one strip per day between dashed scissor cuts, the day set sideways at its head, a day without classes left as a torn stub.

tokens.--font-display: heavy grotesque for headings, the site title, class names, the sideways day names, table headings and the Try a class block
tokens.--font-body: typewriter face for body text, the menu, class times, teacher and level lines, and the footer
tokens.--stretch-display: width of the heading face (condensed packs the sideways day names and long headlines tight)
tokens.--weight-display: weight of headings, class names and day names
tokens.--weight-bold: weight of class times, the current menu item, the first-class note, disciplines, quotes, the No classes line and small labels
tokens.--text-s: small text: teacher and level lines, the Take one label, the strip tail and the footer
tokens.--text-l: the intro line under a title, class names, the timetable heading, the Try a class block and the footer name
tokens.--text-xl: the site title, section headings in text, names in the instructors list and the timetable pointer heading
tokens.--text-hero: the home page headline, set like a flyer
tokens.--text-day: the day names set sideways at the head of each strip
tokens.--color-bg: the lilac copier paper: page background and the strips
tokens.--color-text: black toner: body text, headings, class names and the masthead rule
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: levels, the No classes line, the strip tail, post dates and footer notes
tokens.--color-accent: links, the bar under the current menu item and the keyboard focus ring
tokens.--color-panel: white paste-up panels: page text, instructor cards and the first-class note
tokens.--color-edge: the copied cut edge of paste-up panels, table rows, code blocks and photo borders
tokens.--color-cut: the dashed scissor cuts between strips, the dotted tear line, the torn edge of a stub, rules in page text and the footer cut
tokens.--color-block: solid toner blocks: the Try a class button, the Take one and Today labels, today's day name, the skip link, hovered page links and text selection
tokens.--color-on-block: letters on a toner block, where the paper shows through
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a line of page text
tokens.--strip-min: narrowest a strip may get before the fringe starts a second row
tokens.--head-length: length of the head of each strip, where the day name is set sideways
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right edges of the page
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: inside a class entry
tokens.--space-2: small gap: around labels and under headings
tokens.--space-3: base step: padding inside strips and panels, gap between classes
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections of a page
tokens.--cut-width: thickness of the dashed cuts, the footer cut, rules in page text and the outline of page links
tokens.--cut-dash: length of one dash in the scissor cuts
tokens.--rule: thickness of the masthead rule, the current menu bar, quote bars, table heading rules, the button outline and the focus ring
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height of menu links and buttons
